items.evidence: We reaffirm our full-year guidance and our expectations of 9-11% underlying operating income growth in fiscal 2015.

Assuming no deterioration in current global market conditions, the company is reaffirming its growth outlook for fiscal 2015, including 6-8% growth in reported and underlying net sales, and 9-11% growth in reported and underlying operating income.
